note: Vendored source is based on the old CME build. legacy/discover.py contains live discovery policy: bounded targeted Sponsored Search plus reserved Ads Top performance discovery; automatic FIND requires source-body product/promotion evidence and rejects explicit cross-market delivery signals. Views/likes-only evidence remains an engagement proxy, not revenue. Source-commercial/mechanism and Target-Fit gates remain downstream checks. This branch adds explicit product-head anchors and LOW-confidence family matches when target use context is missing; context-bearing hashtags corroborate product identity but do not prove use context. Raw provider diagnostics retain bounded response metadata (cache state, warnings, dropped-row counts, and response samples) plus playback field paths without storing complete provider responses. Keyword-filtered playback board requests bypass cache; published playback-rate numbers remain unavailable and must not be replaced with retention values. Optional include=retention for pure playback Ads Top boards is off by default; parser preserves provider scale/provenance and does not relabel retention as play rate. Retry feedback includes failed checks for failed MUST atoms even when check.required=false.

REUSE.legacy/discover.py: discover_and_rank: the real discovery, filtering, dedup keys and ranking
REUSE.legacy/market_taxonomy.py: vertical taxonomy loader used by verticals.py
REUSE.legacy/discovery/tiktok_socialcrawl.py: SocialCrawl TikTok Top Ads client (needs SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY)

REUSE_FOR_IMPORT_ONLY.data/verticals/ai_developer_tools.json: market_taxonomy.py builds an alias to this taxonomy at import time; Radar never uses it

ADAPT.find.py: maps discover_and_rank output to the compact Radar record, keeps unknowns unknown

EXCLUDE.source_gate.py: works on downloaded files and LLM verdicts; Radar shows remote preview
EXCLUDE.media.py, discovery/downloader.py, disco: download/OCR pipeline, not needed for manual review
